model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е кръгова диаграма, която показва категории и подкатегории, свързани с герои. Диаграмата включва общо седем основни сегмента, всеки от които е маркиран с етикет - "Comic Characters", "Movie Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Novel Characters", "Game Characters", "Custom Characters" и "Virtual Characters". Всеки от основните сегменти се разделя на допълнителни подкатегории, обозначени вътре в съответния сегмент. Сегментите "Comic Characters", "Movie Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Novel Characters", "Game Characters" и "Virtual Characters" съдържат съответно подкатегории като "Artists", "Scientists", "Writers", "Athletes", "Musicians" и "Real Characters", както и други включващи подкатегории. Сегментите са оцветени в различни нюанси на синьо и зелено. Няма легенда и проценти, показани вътре в секторите. Размерът на сегментите изглежда е организиран визуално по низходящ ред.
model_annotations.English: This pie chart illustrates the composition of "Virtual Characters," displaying the proportion of various categories within this designation. The chart contains a total of twelve slices, each representing a different category. These categories are labeled as Movie Characters (light blue), Comic Characters (light blue), Novel Characters (darker blue), Teleplay Characters (darker blue), Game Characters (blue), Custom Characters (light green), Real Characters (light green), Scientists (green), Athletes (green), Writers (green), Musicians (green), and Influencers (green). The slices are visually arranged in descending order of size, with Movie Characters being the largest segment. The chart includes a legend identifying the color associated with each category, but does not display percentage labels within the slices or visually emphasize any particular segments.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Kreisdiagramm vergleicht verschiedene Arten von Charakteren. Es besteht aus insgesamt 14 Segmenten, die in einer Reihenfolge angeordnet sind, die ungefähr ihrer Größe entspricht. Die Segmente sind Comic-Charaktere (hellblau), Movie Characters (hellgrün), Novel Characters (dunkelgrün), Teleplay Characters (hellgelb), Game Characters (gelbgrün), Custom Characters (gelb), Real Characters (hellgelb), Scientists (orange), Athletes (orange), Writers (gelb), Musicians (hellorange), Actors (orange), Influencers (hellorange) und Artists (rosa). Das Diagramm enthält eine Legende, die jede Kategorie mit ihrer entsprechenden Farbe kennzeichnet.
